title: Evolution drafts declined at the admission gate
description: The drafts a human declined rather than admitted, for one batch. Committed, because whether a draft is still waiting at the gate is derived from what took it or turned it down — not from the directory still holding the file, and not from the ledger, which records that events happened and is never read back as state. Without this record a declined proposal waits at the gate forever.

rejected.description: Append-only. A draft id appears at most once here and never also in an experiment: admitting and declining are both terminal for that proposal, and re-proposing the idea means a new draft id.

draft_sha256.description: The bytes declined. A later draft proposing the same thing is a different proposal, and this is what says so.
